item.title: Will the New Voigtlander 40mm f2 Septon Fail on Sony Cameras?
item.description: Cosina has been one of the few companies to offer exceptional lenses for many young photographers. Their lenses are cost-effective and pretty retro-looking, offering a balance of form and performance. Joining this list is a new lens, one that can offer a perfect blend of wide-angle focal range and bright aperture: Septon 40mm f2. Have a look.

item.title: The 5 Most Important Cameras Panasonic Made for Photography
item.description: Panasonic cameras have become a favourite of many hybrid shooters. One reason is that the company has offered a wide range of features that benefit both groups. But while we appreciate how far they have come, we want to take a moment and see the ones who helped to push the company further ahead in innovation. Have a look.

item.title: Can a Chinese Micro Four Thirds Camera Take on OM System and Panasonic?
item.description: When choosing cameras, many photographers go for trusted brands. For full frame, you have Leica, Canon, Nikon, Sony, and Panasonic; for APS-C, you have Canon and Fujifilm. Just like that, Micro Four Thirds users often choose between Olympus and Panasonic, much of which is based on the user interface, brand visibility, and price point. It now appears that a Chinese brand is here to disrupt the camera market a bit. Here's how.

item.title: The Two Best High-End Cameras From Nikon
item.description: Nikon cameras have had the hearts of many professional photographers. For instance, the FM2 was popular amongst photographers such as Steve McCurry​​, and the Nikon F was used by Don McCullin and Larry Burrows. In the digital era, things began to change, with many serious photographers opting for the Nikon D3 or the D850 as their best options. item.title: 3 Reasons Why This Camera is Nikon’s Best APS-C for Pros
item.description: Nikon has launched interesting cameras over the years, but only a handful have stood the test of time. While the company introduced some exceptional full-frame models, they also took the time to launch APS-C devices that have been on par with their bigger siblings. An example is the Nikon D500, which changed the way pros view smaller-sensor cameras. Here's why the model still shines today.

item.title: WANDRD’s Latest Backpacks Hold Big Kits for Under $350
item.description: Camera backpacks are among the few accessories every photographer relies on. Whether you are shooting indoors or moving between cities, a good camera backpack can protect your devices in challenging conditions. If you are looking to buy a new bag that can help with your needs, then Wandrd's latest launches can be of help. Have a look.

item.title: First Images of the Zeiss Otus ML 35mm f1.4 Are Here
item.description: When Zeiss announced its return after a long hiatus, it sparked celebrations within the community. One of the reasons is that its lenses continue to be cherished by photographers from all around the world. The comeback was marked by the Otus series, one of the highest-end optics available. It now appears the company is launching a third lens, the 35mm f1.4 ML, and the images say a lot.

item.title: Help us Celebrate a Milestone This Month!
item.description: In December 2025, The Phoblographer turned 16 years old. I, as the Editor in Chief/Founder/Publisher, am pretty proud that I've been able to keep the online magazine around for that long. So for the belated sweet 16 and for the month of my personal 39th birthday, I'm giving a special to our readers for the very first time: free presets.

item.title: On the Immense Joy of Printing my Photographs
item.description: Every year, I take a very long vacation for myself in December. And during that time, I did something that I haven't done in a while: I printed.
